about_the_game:
■Game genre: A pixelated exploration action game

  • Game overview

    Fight the enemy and become stronger. When the fight gets tough, transform yourself from the change section. The performance of the character you control will change.

  • Game difficulty

    A little high

  • Play time

    Currently 3-4 hours

■Change

Transformation is essential to the game. If you meet the conditions, you can transform at will. After opening the menu screen, select the transformation destination from the transformation item.The performance of the controlled character will change.

■Language

To switch the language, attack the lever on the right side of the area at the start of the game.

[Controls] Keyboard

  • ALT+F4 or Esc: Force quit

  • Z: Used for talking, confirmation button, and dashing.

  • X: Jump
    Used for both underwater and flying, X+↑ to rise and X+↓ to fall. If you do not enter X, you can move left and right and forward and backward.

  • C: Attack

  • S: Guard or evade. Continuing will consume stamina.
    Only available for some characters.

  • A: Uses red gauge to use special techniques. If equipped with an item, an item attack will occur.

  • Q: Opens the menu screen.

  • P: Enter within the range of a save point to save.

[Controls] Controller

  • X: Attack

  • A: Jump
    Used for both underwater and flying, X+stick↑ to rise and X+stick↓ to fall. If you do not enter X, you can move left and right and forward and backward.

  • B: Talk, confirm, etc.

  • Y: Consume red gauge to use special moves

  • RB: Hold to dash

  • LB: Guard or evade

  • Start: Open the menu screen.

  • Back: Enter within range of a save point to save.

content_descriptors.notes: Depiction of violence to the extent that you attack an enemy and the opponent is damaged and falls down.
